receiving_affine_model.locator: Paper I early A3.1 proper-family construction, display (PD7)
receiving_affine_model.literal: (z,c,zeta) maps to (g_j z,c,R_gj(z) zeta+Pi(g_j z,c) v_j/m_j), (m1,m2)=(3,4). In the real marking: (z,c,u) maps to (g_j z,c,A_j u+v_j/m_j).

engel_positive_root_model.locator: Construction 3.5, pp. 10–11; Lemma 3.6, p. 11; analogous order-four construction immediately below
engel_positive_root_model.literal: Positive-root generator s maps to zeta_3*s; rho_tilde(x)=rho(x)+a0; v0=3*a0. sigma_a0(s)=(log(s)/(2*pi*i))*v0; Psi_a0(x,s)=(x+sigma_a0(s),s). sigma_a0(zeta_3*s)=T0^(-1)*sigma_a0(s)+a0 and Psi_a0 composed with rho = rho_tilde composed with Psi_a0. The same construction is stated for a1 in (1/4)*Lambda^(T1).
